The Laws We Live By

A thief has been caught stealing supplies; as punishment, he will lose the hand he stole with.

As he leaves the chamber, {d(Child)} turns to you. "Why are we doing this to him?"
Those supplies are ours. Never let anyone take advantage like that.
"Theft is an affront to our dignity", you sneer
"Defend what's yours, child," you growl, "by any means necessary. I know I will, once this thief's been dealt with."
Storehouse security restrictions
Responding to storage thefts, {House} have increased their storehouse security.
Storehouse security restrictions

"Without the law, we're animals," {Child} murmurs.

The next day, you find a dozen food tins in {d_s(Child)} quarters
"They're mine!" {he(Child)} snaps. "Hands off!"
Taking a Compliment
"That courtier was so kind to you!" {Child} exclaims. "Why did you brush off their compliment?"
We are only great through the help of our people.
"The people make the leader," you explain
"Not the power."
We mustn't open up to people. It makes us vulnerable.
"In fact," you mutter, "security could be tighter..."
Over the next few days, you work to eradicate vulnerabilities from your security.

"I'll show you," you grin

The man scowls, and kneels.

"Wait! Do we really have to kill him?"

You execute the criminal
Your scientists devise a terrible punishment

"Why have you brought me here?" your ward asks.
It's so vast. Remember: we are tiny specks in an infinite cosmos.
